entities.summary: Halla Tómasdóttir is an Icelandic businesswoman and politician who is president of Iceland since 2024. She is Iceland's second female president, after Vigdís Finnbogadóttir. Before becoming president, Halla was a public speaker and the chief executive of The B Team, a global nonprofit group.
